title: Digital TDS Meter 661(Portable)
excerpt: Designed in ABS Plastic to provide the rugged portability matched in fields with the accuracy demanded in the laboratory. A beautiful carrying case holds every thing needed in the field operation. These are useful test instruments to measure TDS (Total Dissolve Solids) of any solution in the fields, laboratory or plant.
